# PUBLIK Bengaluru

> PUBLIK is a free, independent website that lists 1,886 public places in Bengaluru (Bangalore): parks, playgrounds, lakes, libraries and public toilets. Each place has opening times where known, features, and a directions link. No sign-in.

Timings come from the BBMP park list (via OpenCity), OpenStreetMap and Google Maps. They can be out of date. Data built 2026-10-09. Not every place has timings, and the pages say so when they are not known.

## Pages

- [Home: the map, search and open-now status](https://publik.nxtduo.com/)
- [Parks in Bengaluru](https://publik.nxtduo.com/parks/): 1085 places, 503 with timings
- [Playgrounds in Bengaluru](https://publik.nxtduo.com/playgrounds/): 66 places, 26 with timings
- [Lakes in Bengaluru](https://publik.nxtduo.com/lakes/): 186 places, 9 with timings
- [Libraries in Bengaluru](https://publik.nxtduo.com/libraries/): 96 places, 57 with timings
- [Public toilets in Bengaluru](https://publik.nxtduo.com/public-toilets/): 453 places, 164 with timings

## Places

Each place has a page at https://publik.nxtduo.com/place/<name-area>/ with timings, features, directions and nearby places. The sitemap at https://publik.nxtduo.com/sitemap.xml lists the 806 place pages that have timings or features.

## Credits

BBMP park list via OpenCity. OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Google Maps for some timings.
